name: Emma Ytterell - Amendements de la commission compétente - vote séparé - Am 69
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: Deleted Administrative costs of environmental assessments Member States shall endeavour to waive administrative charges and fees associated with environmental assessments for developers falling within the definition of small mid-cap enterprises under Recommendation (EU) 2025/1099 or within the definition of small and medium-sized enterprises under Recommendation 361/2003/EC.
